missions.title: Initial Inference
missions.description: A single glance was not enough to plumb the depths, so they used even greater weights.

missions.title: Analytic Inference
missions.description: The only answer the questioner received was a riddle that repeats itself.

missions.title: Transcendental Inference
missions.description: When the answer refused to appear, the seeker chose to raise the staks to the maximum.

missions.title: Interpolation Analysis
missions.description: When all variables are exhausted to no avail, it invites the unknown called "humanity".

missions.title: Error Analysis
missions.description: Silence is acceptance, just as how a victory outside the rules is granted the right to persist.

missions.title: Asymptotic Analysis
missions.description: The clamor of data condenses into a single conclusion.

missions.title: Harmonic Simulation
missions.description: In the vacuum of rules, all actions exist merely to fill the void of data.

missions.title: Bayesian Decision
missions.description: When an expedition of reason is lost in the sea of data, the most direct physical interference can instead make for the smoothest of sailing.
